title: pt2 validation must not mutate torch's process-wide safe_globals registry
answers: concurrent torch.load weights_only fails after mlflow loads a pt2 model
add_safe_globals interferes with mlflow pytorch load
allowlisted torch global executes during pt2 validation
UnpicklingError when loading checkpoint while pt2 model loads
body:
Invariant: validation must not add to or clear torch.serialization's global registry. torch's weights_only unpickler honors globals registered with add_safe_globals, so a crafted record could invoke an allowlisted callable during validation.
Enforced by mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py:_pickle_globals, which scans each checkpoint's data.pkl with pickletools for GLOBAL and STACK_GLOBAL references. _user_registered_safe_globals reads torch.serialization.get_safe_globals(), and a record that references one of those names, or that cannot be parsed statically, is rejected (fail closed).
What breaks if skipped: an earlier revision cleared the registry around validation. A reviewer reproduced UnpicklingError in unrelated concurrent weights_only loads on PyTorch 2.8. Leaving the registry honored lets a crafted payload run allowlisted code.
applies: Any change to pt2 record validation in mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py or any other code that calls torch.load(weights_only=True) on untrusted input.
says: Simultaneous model checkpoint loads fail when another thread validates an exported model archive.
Malicious model archives invoke approved global functions during background security verification checks.
Inspect model archives safely without modifying the application's shared safe type registry.
Prevent model security scans from disrupting concurrent model loading in the same process.
Unparseable model files or references to allowlisted callables should be rejected immediately.
search: Archive validation in mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py:_validate_pt2_archive_is_pickle_free must not add to or clear torch.serialization's global safe registry. Clearing the registry causes UnpicklingError in concurrent weights_only loads on PyTorch 2.8, while honoring registered globals allows crafted archives to invoke allowlisted callables during validation. Enforced by _pickle_globals scanning data.pkl via pickletools for GLOBAL and STACK_GLOBAL references, while _user_registered_safe_globals checks torch.serialization.get_safe_globals() and fails closed on matches or static parse failures. Applies to pt2 record validation in mlflow/pytorch/__init__.py and code calling torch.load(weights_only=True) on untrusted input.
